title: Glenn Close finally gets her Oscar at the Governors Awards
summary: The actress, nominated eight times without winning, received an honorary award and a standing ovation.
body:
Glenn Close received an honorary Oscar at the Academy's Governors Awards in Hollywood on Sunday 15 November, after eight nominations over five decades without a competitive win.

The award was presented by John Malkovich, her co-star in Dangerous Liaisons. Close was moved to tears as the room gave her a standing ovation.

The other honourees

Director Ridley Scott, who could not travel, accepted his honorary Oscar by video after an introduction from Matt Damon. The animator Floyd Norman also received an honorary award, and producers Christine Vachon and Pamela Koffler were given the Irving G. Thalberg Memorial Award.

Sources: Deadline, Variety, Anadolu Agency.
